column3: MT 52:1–3; the following verses of this psalm are MT +2. NASB sets the title in braces, but this copy closes the brace early and puts the rest of the title in parentheses. NASB supplies “endures” in the last line.
Close to the Hebrew; “plots” is rendered “devises.”
Close to the Hebrew; “words of swallowing” is rendered “words that devour.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from a tent” is rendered “from your tent.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “saying” to introduce verse 7.
Close to the Hebrew; “his destruction” is rendered “his evil desire.”
Close to the Hebrew; “luxuriant” is rendered “green.”
